entries.title: LivePortrait
entries.body: Efficient portrait animation — implicit keypoints, stitching/retargeting. Driving: video, audio, text, or template .pkl. Gradio app.py, inference.py. Best open path for Hostess7 live face on Graphics window.

entries.title: Ditto Talking Head
entries.body: Ant Group — real-time streaming talking head; diffusion-based, low latency for live conversation.

entries.title: MuseTalk
entries.body: Real-time high quality lip sync — audio in, talking face out. Good TTS→face bridge.

entries.title: Wav2Lip
entries.body: Accurate lip-sync to any speech audio — baseline for Hostess7 voice+face pipeline.

entries.title: SadTalker
entries.body: Single image + audio → talking head video. 3D motion coefficients; slower than LivePortrait.

entries.title: OmniTalker
entries.body: Real-time text-driven talking head — unified framework for live speech synthesis + face.

entries.title: LiveAvatar (Quark)
entries.body: Alibaba Quark live avatar stack — streaming digital human for conversation UIs.

entries.title: Awesome Talking Head Generation
entries.body: Curated papers and repos for talking-head generation — keep Hostess7 registry updated from here.

entries.title: Grok Imagine Video 1.5
entries.body: xAI grok-imagine-video-1.5 — animate still → video, 6–15s, async poll. Hostess cinematic shots; not sub-100ms live lip-sync — pair with LivePortrait for talk.

entries.title: FasterLivePortrait
entries.body: TensorRT/ONNX LivePortrait — real-time camera + audio drive (JoyVASA, Kokoro TTS). Best GPU path when sub-100ms lip-sync matters for Hostess7 Graphics window.

entries.title: Teller
entries.body: CVPR 2025 — first autoregressive real-time streaming audio-driven portrait. 0.92s per second of video vs Hallo 20.93s. Facial + body detail via ETM.

entries.title: Livatar-1
entries.body: Hedra flow-matching talking heads — strong lip-sync (8.50 confidence HDTF) at real-time throughput.

entries.title: REST
entries.body: Diffusion-based real-time end-to-end streaming THG — ID-Context Cache + Asynchronous Streaming Distillation. State-of-the-art speed for diffusion talking heads.

entries.title: EGSTalker
entries.body: 3D Gaussian Splatting talking head — 3–5 min training video, ESAA audio-spatial fusion, fast inference.

entries.title: Hallo
entries.body: Fudan diffusion portrait animation — high quality but slower; baseline Teller/REST compare against.

entries.title: Hallo-Live
entries.body: Fudan streaming variant of Hallo — closer to live conversation than batch Hallo.

entries.title: PersonaLive
entries.body: CVPR 2026 — expressive portrait animation for live streaming; image-driven reenactment at speed.

entries.title: HunyuanPortrait
entries.body: CVPR 2025 implicit condition portrait animation — Tencent Hunyuan family.

entries.title: FlashPortrait
entries.body: 6× faster infinite portrait animation with adaptive latent prediction — long-form live sessions.

entries.title: JoyVASA
entries.body: Audio drives portrait via LivePortrait motion — used inside FasterLivePortrait for real-time talk.

entries.title: ACTalker
entries.body: ICCV 2025 — simultaneous audio + expression control for portrait video generation.

entries.title: Talking Head Survey 2025
entries.body: Comprehensive survey of multi-modal talking-head methods, datasets, metrics — map the field.

entries.title: Awesome Talking Head Synthesis
entries.body: Alternate curated paper/repo list — cross-check with harlanhong awesome-talking-head-generation.

entries.title: Talking Face arXiv Daily
entries.body: Daily arXiv talking-face paper feed — keep Hostess7 registry current.

entries.title: Grok reference-to-video
entries.body: grok-imagine-video (not 1.5) — guide video with reference images without fixing frame 1. Cinematic Hostess shots; pair with open-source lip-sync for sub-second talk.

entries.title: Grok text-to-video
entries.body: Text prompt → video up to 15s, aspect ratio + resolution. B-roll and scene cuts, not live lip-sync.

entries.title: Open-source live pipeline pattern
entries.body: Live talk pattern: mic/text → LLM reply → TTS (piper/coqui/edge-tts/kokoro) → lip-sync (FasterLivePortrait/MuseTalk/LivePortrait) → frame stream → Graphics/GTK window. Hostess7: HOSTESS7_VOICE=1 + HOSTESS7_LIVE_VIDEO_BACKEND + field_live_video.sync_talk_reply().
